runs.name: f0-tissues
runs.description: the three designed tissues placed in an empty-ish dish (default scene, 60 cells) at 2 s, 120 s

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); const out = []; for (const [k, n] of [['plant', 0.25], ['filament', 0.5], ['biofilm', 0.75]]) out.push(await moire.tissues.place(k, { x: v.cssW * n, y: v.cssH * 0.5, n: 40 })); return JSON.stringify(out)
const s = moire.cells.stats; return JSON.stringify({t: s && s.time, job: s && s.job, alive: moire.cells.alive})
